thread:
deploy-bot: DeployCheck failed for release v2026.03.21-canary — blocked by keystore metadata mismatch between staging and prod.

deploy-bot: Summary: staging keystore path: /keystore/eu-west/ttl=3600; prod keystore path: /keystore/eu-central/ttl=0. mismatch prevents canary promotion.

sara: ugh, where did the region tag get swapped? staging should mirror prod.

jon: digging — helm values in the staging overlay set `keystore.region: eu-west-1`, prod is `eu-central-1`. also noticed a sidecar change added a `timezone` label that affects TTL parsing.

kevin: that explains the TTL difference. prod intentionally had TTL=0 (legacy tokens).

maria: decision needed: rollback the canary or hotfix values and re-run deploycheck? change window in ~10m.

release-manager-bot: Change window policy: if we cannot safely complete a hotfix in 15m, prefer rollback to pinned image. tagging owners.

jon: proposed quick fix: patch helm values to match prod and pin the keystore revision so deploybot doesn't auto-resolve: `keystore.region=eu-central-1, keystoreHash=sha256:abcd1234`. test in canary first.

sara: also saw path normalization issue — staging had `/keystore/region//key` (double slash) vs prod `/keystore/region/key`. that likely caused the lookup to fall back and change TTL semantics.

kevin: i can push the helm override in CI: `helm upgrade --install svc --set keystore.region=eu-central-1 --set keystoreHash=sha256:abcd1234 --reuse-values ...` and re-trigger deploycheck.

maria: +1 to pin+canary. if canary fails we rollback.

release-manager-bot: deploybot remains blocked until deploycheck passes. permitting a single hotfix outside window for safety. @kevin @jon please proceed.

jon: rolling patch now. logs: ```
deploybot: starting rollout v2026.03.21-canary-patch
deploybot: applying helm overrides
deploybot: healthcheck ok (3/3)
```

sara: smoke tests OK on canary. keystore lookup returns expected path and TTL=0 (matches prod). no secret parsing errors.

maria: good. we should promote to staging but hold prod promotion until the scheduled window. monitor metrics for 1h.

kevin: promoting to staging now. creating a short follow-up to normalize secret path across envs so this doesn't recur.

sara: filing ticket INF-412: "keystore path normalization + migration + test harness" — assigned to security/infra.

maria: final action list: @jon apply helm pin, @kevin push canary & promote to staging, @sara open ticket, @maria hold prod promotion until next window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Releasecheck OK after patch. Release unblocked for canary/staging; prod promotion pending scheduled window.
